rules_checked.rule: tree_id extraction MUST use regex _T(\d+)__ on title only
rules_checked.evidence: re.search(r'_T(\d+)__', title) applied to BrodyMemoryDoc.title field only. path and text_preview matches excluded from PLAN (moved to EXCLUDED_REVIEW).

rules_checked.rule: family assignment MUST come from arbres_34.canon.json lookup by id
rules_checked.evidence: Family assigned via CANON[tnum]['family'] lookup only. 0 heuristic assignments.
All 48 entries have heuristic=false. Docs without explicit _Tnn__ in title are in EXCLUDED_REVIEW, not in PLAN.
All 48 entries have llm_guess=false. No LLM inference of tree family from text content.
All 48 entries have invention=false. All tree_ids in {T01..T12} validated against CANON. No invented tags.

rules_checked.rule: existing tags MUST be preserved — append only
rules_checked.evidence: All 48 entries have append_only=true. proposed_tags_to_keep = current_tags (no removal). proposed_tags_final = sorted(set(current_tags + proposed_add)).

rules_checked.rule: all writes require KX108 gate + writable memory protocol activation
rules_checked.evidence: All 48 entries have neo4j_write_planned=false, graphiti_write_planned=false, memory_intake=false. Gate not opened.

rules_checked.evidence: boundary_all_false=true confirmed. No Neo4j write, no Graphiti write, no memory intake, no runtime binding.
